changes.title: Make uar-driver genuinely opt-in
changes.note: Highest leverage per line changed. Removes the surrealdb lockstep pin and UAR's whole transitive tree from the DEFAULT build. Ships first, independent of the sidecar work.

changes.title: [UPSTREAM] Build and publish the uar-sidecar binary
changes.note: HARD BLOCKER. uar-sidecar is never built (0 refs in release.yml; Dockerfile:225 builds only --bin universal-agent-runtime). Start this in parallel with C-001/C-003 — everything that spawns UAR waits on it.

changes.title: Generalize bundled-binary resolution; fail loudly when unresolvable
changes.note: This is the actual bug fix. resolve_sidecar_command (sidecar.rs:728) is hardcoded to the Telegram stem, so UAR falls through to a bare PATH lookup. Testable with NO UAR binary present — that is precisely what the regression test asserts.

changes.title: Ship the UAR binary in the BossFang image and release tarball
changes.note: COPY --from=<uar-image>, landing the binary beside /usr/local/bin/librefang so C-003 step-1 resolves it. Image-size delta MUST be measured, not assumed.

changes.title: UAR sidecar config surface
changes.note: UarConfig has no enable flag and nothing to spawn. Trap: base_url is an LLM-PROVIDER override (drivers/uar.rs:97), NOT a UAR endpoint — reusing it is a silent semantic collision.

changes.title: UAR sidecar supervisor (spawn, READY handshake, health, restart, shutdown)
changes.note: REUSE the existing supervisor (sidecar.rs:502-520 already has restart+backoff). Genuinely new: the READY:{port} stdout handshake and stdin-EOF shutdown. Build a FAKE contract-honouring uar-sidecar so CI is hermetic.

changes.title: UarDriver becomes an HTTP + SSE client
changes.note: Zero new dependencies — reqwest 0.13 (stream) + futures + tokio-stream are already in the workspace. Add a startup version check: with the cargo pin gone, drift becomes a silent runtime failure instead of a compile error.

changes.title: Web console: run, stop, restart, and test the UAR
changes.note: The user-visible goal. Status must expose the RESOLVED BINARY PATH so a resolution failure is diagnosable from the console, not the logs.

Is desktop/local support in v1? UAR's release.yml:160 calls its cross-platform binaries 'aspirational' — Linux/container is unaffected
